name: certen-sdk-monorepo
description: Client libraries for the CERTEN Gateway API
//workspaces: The CLI and MCP server are the SDK's only consumers and they ship in lockstep, so they live together and resolve @certen.io/sdk from packages/sdk during development while declaring a published range for consumers.
//scripts: spec:refresh is the only step that touches the network. Everything else is derived from the vendored spec/openapi.json, so tests and CI stay offline and deterministic.
